title: Bruce Willis, 70, seen out as 'health battle worsens' leaving him unable to speak or walk - NewsBreak
text: Bruce Willis was spotted taking a quiet drive through Studio City this week, a rare public sighting for the retired actor as his health allegedly continues to decline. Photographed in the passenger seat of his black SUV, Willis , 70, appeared calm during the one-hour-long outing alongside his longtime bodyguard. The actor, best known for his roles in the Die Hard franchise , has remained out of the public eye since his family confirmed his dementia diagnosis in 2023. The Los Angeles sighting comes as reports claim that Willis is now struggling with severe symptoms of a degenerative condition, which has reportedly left him non-verbal and affected his mobility. In April, his family acknowledged that his condition remains stable but progressive. Willis, who was first diagnosed with aphasia in 2022, a language disorder that impacts speech and comprehension, stepped away from acting soon after. The diagnosis was later revealed to be frontotemporal dementia (FTD), a rarer form of dementia that affects personality, behavior, and communication. "I wish I had asked you more questions while you could still tell me about it all. I can still hold you and hug you... I'll try to just be grateful," his daughter Rumer posted on social media at the time. Rumer, Scout, and Tallulah Willis, his daughters with actress Demi Moore, have joined Emma in using their social media platforms to raise awareness of FTD.
